pairs.evidence: src-tauri/db/src/repos/fleet_sessions.rs:327 list_by_run (the harvest roster read at src-tauri/src/commands/fleet/commands.rs:589) drops any row failing map_row via filter_map(Result::ok), as does list_rehydratable on restart (:255), so a corrupt member silently leaves the run denominator and the booted fleet while the queue read (:461) surfaces the same failure. Re-judged at rev 28: unchanged.

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/db/src/repos/fleet_sessions.rs:327 a member that fails to map is dropped from the roster; the technique requires accounts to sum to the roster and a misfit to fail loudly
src-tauri/db/src/repos/fleet_sessions.rs:255 restart rehydration skips unreadable rows instead of declaring them, so a session vanishes on boot

pairs.evidence: src-tauri/src/engine/build_session/fanout.rs:1354 a capability lane that fails while siblings succeed is only a tracing::warn, assemble_agent_ir reads lanes (:958) without res.error, and only all-lanes-failed is refused (:1365), so a persona with silently unresolved capabilities reaches DraftReady with no partial account. Re-judged at rev 28: unchanged.

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/src/engine/build_session/fanout.rs:1365 partial failure is not a first-class outcome: only total failure is refused
src-tauri/src/engine/build_session/fanout.rs:118 the lane brief orders 'do NOT ask clarifying questions - pick sensible defaults', giving the worker no failure channel for an unresolvable capability

pairs.subject: fleet-orchestration
pairs.evidence: src/features/notepad/notepadActions.ts:186 dispatchNoteToFleet launches a write-capable /note-task session with cwd = project.root_path (the shared repo root), declares no write set or isolated workspace, and the admission door (src-tauri/src/commands/fleet/queue.rs:996 door_verdict_for) decides on cap, time gate, budget and queue order only, so two notes dispatched into one repo can collide on files. Re-judged at rev 28: unchanged.

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/fleet/queue.rs:996 no write-set disjointness check at the one admission door; the technique makes overlap a dispatch-time rejection or a queueing decision

pairs.evidence: src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_triage/findings/dispatch.ts:85 spawns a Fleet session for a finding with no dispatch-key check and discards the returned session id, so the task row created at :80 is never bound to the session; a re-fired signal opens a duplicate and nothing can find the session again. Re-judged at rev 28: unchanged.

techniques.evidence: src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_triage/findings/dispatch.ts:85 no key derived from the work (idea id) is checked or persisted; the technique treats an unnamed spawn as a failed dispatch
